title: M3 — Recover and manage worker tasks reliably
description: Make task state visible and durable. Start with a bounded worker queue and one writer per workspace. Add provider health, timeout and restart behavior before increasing concurrency. Define typed workspace-scoped input through Mastra Signals: route user messages and asynchronous worker/CI events to a selected assistant thread, while keeping durable worker lifecycle in the application task store and planning decisions in Plantool. Specify thread selection, per-thread ordering, notification payload retrieval, deduplication, retries and recovery before implementing event ingress.
why: Managed agents must stay understandable when processes fail or conversations change.

acceptance.text: A worker failure or assistant restart does not silently lose or duplicate work
Durable intake ledger accepts validated events with dedupe before Mastra dispatch
Worker completion and progress reach the owning conversation via notifications without re-running tasks
Notification inbox tool lets the model read full stored payloads safely

outcome.summary: M3 complete: task store, worker registry, signals intake+notifications (c3ce454).
